item.title: Vance Havner (Devotional) & E. S. James, "The Promised Messiah" (pt. 1 of 2) — 1963 Pastor's Conference, Mon AM Pt. 1
item.description: Monday morning session, May 6, 1963, Kansas City, MO. Per the printed program: 9:00 Music; 9:05 Scripture & Prayer, W. Ross Edwards (MO); 9:10 Welcome Address, Thomas S. Field (MO); 9:15 Response, T. L. McSwain (KY); 9:20 Devotional, Vance Havner (NC); 9:50 Music; 9:55 "The Promised Messiah," E. S. James (TX) — continues into Part 2. Segment boundaries are estimated from the printed program's schedule (assuming a 9:00 start) and are not verified by listening; the full program is linked below. Full printed program: http://media2.sbhla.org.s3.amazonaws.com/collections/sbc_pastors_conf/sbc_pc_1963.pdf

item.title: Warren Hultgren, "The Love of God" (pt. 2, concl.) / Afternoon Concert & Vance Havner (Devotional) — 1963 Pastor's Conference, Mon AM Pt. 4 – PM Pt. 1
item.description: This file bridges the end of Monday morning and the start of Monday afternoon (a lunch break between 12:10 and 1:45 is not captured in the recording). Per the printed program: conclusion of "The Love of God," Warren Hultgren (OK); 12:10 Closing Prayer, Arthur H. Stainback (MO); [lunch break]; 1:45 Concert, West End Baptist Chancel Choir (Birmingham, AL, Larry Andrews directing); 2:05 Scripture & Prayer, Tilford L. Junkins (AL); 2:10 Devotional, Vance Havner (NC) — likely continues into Part 5. Segment boundaries are estimated from the printed program's schedule and are not verified by listening; the full program is linked below. Full printed program: http://media2.sbhla.org.s3.amazonaws.com/collections/sbc_pastors_conf/sbc_pc_1963.pdf

item.title: Charles B. Howard (Devotional) & John E. Huss, "The Church That Jesus Built" (pt. 1) — 1963 Pastor's Conference, Tue AM Pt. 1
item.description: Tuesday morning session, May 7, 1963. Per the printed program: 9:00 Music; 9:10 Scripture & Prayer, Paul Denington (TN); 9:15 Devotional, Charles B. Howard (NC); 9:45 Music; 9:50 "The Church That Jesus Built," John E. Huss (SC) — continues beyond this file. Note: this session also includes "The New Birth" (K. Owen White), "The Christian Home" (Jess C. Moody), and "The Cross of Christ" (W. A. Criswell) later in the day, not yet included in this feed. Segment boundaries are estimated from the printed program's schedule and are not verified by listening; the full program is linked below. Full printed program: http://media2.sbhla.org.s3.amazonaws.com/collections/sbc_pastors_conf/sbc_pc_1963.pdf
